import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
TUFTE_RC = {
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.figsize": (13, 13),
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.labelcolor": "#666666",
    "axes.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.titlesize": 15,
    "axes.titleweight": "normal",
    "axes.titlepad": 8,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.color": "#999999",
    "ytick.color": "#999999",
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "xtick.direction": "in",
    "ytick.direction": "in",
    "xtick.major.size": 3,
    "ytick.major.size": 3,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.5,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.5,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
    "lines.markersize": 3,
    "legend.frameon": False,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.3,
}
plt.rcParams.update(TUFTE_RC)

# ── Color constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text2": "#666666",
    "text3": "#999999",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
    "highlight": "#e41a1c",
    "steel": "#4e79a7",
    "tangerine": "#f28e2b",
    "coral": "#e15759",
    "sage": "#76b7b2",
    "gray": "#666666",
}

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Tariff rates (half-yearly)
tariff_raw = [
    ("2017-H1", 3.1, 8.0), ("2017-H2", 3.1, 8.0),
    ("2018-H1", 3.8, 8.0), ("2018-H2", 12.0, 16.5),
    ("2019-H1", 18.3, 20.7), ("2019-H2", 21.0, 21.8),
    ("2020-H1", 19.3, 20.9), ("2020-H2", 19.3, 20.9),
    ("2021-H1", 19.3, 20.9), ("2021-H2", 19.3, 20.9),
    ("2022-H1", 19.3, 21.1), ("2022-H2", 19.3, 21.1),
    ("2023-H1", 19.3, 21.2), ("2023-H2", 19.3, 21.2),
    ("2024-H1", 25.4, 23.1),
]

def p2n(period_str):
    """Convert 'YYYY-HX' to decimal year."""
    y, h = period_str.split("-H")
    return int(y) + (0.0 if h == "1" else 0.5)

tx = np.array([p2n(r[0]) for r in tariff_raw])
us_tariff = np.array([r[1] for r in tariff_raw])
cn_tariff = np.array([r[2] for r in tariff_raw])

# Bilateral trade (annual)
trade_years = np.array([2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024])
us_exports = np.array([115.6, 129.9, 120.3, 106.4, 124.5, 151.1, 153.8, 147.8, 138.2])
us_imports = np.array([462.6, 505.5, 539.5, 452.2, 435.4, 506.4, 536.8, 427.2, 401.5])
total_trd  = np.array([578.2, 635.4, 659.8, 558.6, 559.9, 657.5, 690.6, 575.0, 539.7])

# Supply chain shares (annual)
sc_years = np.array([2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024])
china_sc   = np.array([21.4, 21.6, 21.2, 18.1, 18.6, 17.9, 16.5, 13.9, 12.8])
vietnam_sc = np.array([2.1, 2.2, 2.6, 2.9, 3.4, 3.7, 3.9, 4.5, 4.9])
india_sc   = np.array([2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.3, 2.7, 2.8, 3.1, 3.4])

# Policy events (key inflection points only)
events = [
    (2017.62, "Section 301 Investigation\nInitiated", C["text2"], -28),
    (2018.51, "List 1: 25% tariff\non $34B Chinese goods", C["highlight"], 18),
    (2019.36, "List 3 raised to 25%\non $200B Chinese goods", C["highlight"], 10),
    (2020.04, "Phase One\nTrade Deal Signed", C["steel"], -40),
    (2021.76, "USTR Tariff\nReview Framework", C["text2"], 18),
    (2024.37, "Biden raises tariffs:\nEVs 100%, semi 50%", C["highlight"], 12),
]

# ── Create figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, (ax1, ax2, ax3) = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(13, 13), sharex=True)

# ── Panel 1: Tariff Rates ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Plot tariffs
ax1.plot(tx, us_tariff, color=C["highlight"], linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
ax1.plot(tx, cn_tariff, color=C["steel"], linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)

# Shaded reference zone: pre-trade-war baseline
ax1.axhspan(0, 3.5, xmin=0, xmax=(2017.5 - 2016) / 9, color=C["text3"], alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
ax1.text(2016.15, 1.5, "Pre-trade-war\nbaseline", fontsize=9, color=C["text3"],
         fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", va="bottom")

# Direct labels at rightmost points
ax1.text(tx[-1] + 0.12, us_tariff[-1], "US tariff on Chinese goods",
         fontsize=11, color=C["highlight"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")
ax1.text(tx[-1] + 0.12, cn_tariff[-1], "China tariff on US goods",
         fontsize=11, color=C["steel"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")

# Policy event markers
for ex, label, color, yoff in events:
    ax1.axvline(x=ex, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, linestyle="--", zorder=0)
    ax1.annotate(label,
                 xy=(ex, 26), xytext=(0, 36),
                 textcoords="offset points",
                 fontsize=8.5, color=color, fontfamily="serif",
                 fontstyle="italic", ha="center", va="bottom",
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=C["axis"], lw=0.4))

# Panel label
ax1.text(2015.85, 27, "Tariff Escalation", fontsize=12, color=C["text"],
         fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", va="top")

# Range-frame + styling
ax1.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(2016, 2024.5)
ax1.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 26)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 30)
ax1.set_yticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25])
ax1.set_ylabel("Average tariff rate (%)", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])

# ── Panel 2: Bilateral Trade Volume ────────────────────────────────
ax2.fill_between(trade_years, 0, total_trd, color=C["gray"], alpha=0.06, zorder=1)
ax2.plot(trade_years, total_trd, color=C["gray"], linewidth=2.0, zorder=3)
ax2.plot(trade_years, us_imports, color=C["tangerine"], linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)
ax2.plot(trade_years, us_exports, color=C["sage"], linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)

# Mark the 2018 peak and 2019 trough
ax2.scatter([2018], [659.8], color=C["highlight"], s=20, zorder=4, clip_on=False)
ax2.annotate("2018 peak\n$660B",
             xy=(2018, 659.8), xytext=(2017.5, 680),
             fontsize=9, color=C["highlight"], fontfamily="serif",
             fontstyle="italic", ha="center",
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=C["axis"], lw=0.4))

ax2.scatter([2019], [558.6], color=C["steel"], s=20, zorder=4, clip_on=False)
ax2.annotate("2019 dip:\n$559B",
             xy=(2019, 558.6), xytext=(2019, 520),
             fontsize=9, color=C["steel"], fontfamily="serif",
             fontstyle="italic", ha="center",
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=C["axis"], lw=0.4))

# Direct labels
ax2.text(trade_years[-1] + 0.12, total_trd[-1], "Total bilateral\ntrade", fontsize=11,
         color=C["gray"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")
ax2.text(trade_years[-1] + 0.12, us_imports[-1], "US imports\nfrom China", fontsize=10,
         color=C["tangerine"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")
ax2.text(trade_years[-1] + 0.12, us_exports[-1], "US exports\nto China", fontsize=10,
         color=C["sage"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")

# Panel label
ax2.text(2015.85, 720, "Bilateral Trade Volume", fontsize=12, color=C["text"],
         fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", va="top")

ax2.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(2016, 2024.5)
ax2.spines["left"].set_bounds(100, 700)
ax2.set_ylim(80, 740)
ax2.set_ylabel("USD billions", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])

# ── Panel 3: Supply Chain Diversification ──────────────────────────
ax3.plot(sc_years, china_sc, color=C["coral"], linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
ax3.plot(sc_years, vietnam_sc, color=C["steel"], linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)
ax3.plot(sc_years, india_sc, color=C["sage"], linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)

# 2018 reference line marking trade war start
ax3.axvline(x=2018, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, linestyle="--", zorder=0)
ax3.text(2018.15, 1.5, "Trade war\nbegins", fontsize=9, color=C["text3"],
         fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic")

# Arrow annotations for diversion
ax3.annotate("",
             xy=(2020.5, 17.0), xytext=(2022.5, 17.0),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=C["coral"], lw=0.8))
ax3.text(2020, 18.0, "China share\n−8.6 pp since 2017", fontsize=9,
         color=C["coral"], fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", ha="center")

ax3.annotate("",
             xy=(2021.5, 4.2), xytext=(2020.0, 4.2),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=C["steel"], lw=0.8))
ax3.text(2018.8, 4.8, "Vietnam +133%", fontsize=9,
         color=C["steel"], fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", ha="center")

ax3.annotate("",
             xy=(2022.5, 3.0), xytext=(2021.0, 3.0),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=C["sage"], lw=0.8))
ax3.text(2020.5, 3.5, "India +62%", fontsize=9,
         color=C["sage"], fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", ha="center")

# Direct labels
ax3.text(sc_years[-1] + 0.12, china_sc[-1], "China", fontsize=11,
         color=C["coral"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")
ax3.text(sc_years[-1] + 0.12, vietnam_sc[-1] + 0.1, "Vietnam", fontsize=11,
         color=C["steel"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")
ax3.text(sc_years[-1] + 0.12, india_sc[-1] - 0.1, "India", fontsize=11,
         color=C["sage"], fontfamily="serif", va="center")

# Panel label
ax3.text(2015.85, 23.5, "Share of Total US Goods Imports", fontsize=12, color=C["text"],
         fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", va="top")

ax3.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(2016, 2024.5)
ax3.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 23)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 24)
ax3.set_ylabel("Percent of total US imports", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])

# ── Shared x-axis ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax3.set_xlim(2015.8, 2025.2)
ax3.set_xticks([2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024])
ax3.set_xticklabels(["2016", "2017", "2018", "2019", "2020", "2021", "2022", "2023", "2024"])
ax3.set_xlabel("")

# ── Titles ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.08, 0.975, "The US–China Trade War: Tariff Escalation, Trade Disruption, and Supply Chain Restructuring",
         fontsize=18, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text"])
fig.text(0.08, 0.952, "Average tariff rates surged from ~3% to 25% (US) and 8% to 23% (China); bilateral trade dipped then partially recovered;\n"
         "China's share of US imports fell from 21.6% to 12.8% as Vietnam and India captured diverted sourcing.",
         fontsize=11, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text2"], linespacing=1.5)

# Source note
fig.text(0.08, 0.005, "Source: Trade-weighted average tariff estimates; US Census Bureau trade data. Tariff data for 2024 is H1 only. Supply chain shares rounded.",
         fontsize=8.5, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text3"], fontstyle="italic")

plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.88, top=0.93, bottom=0.06, hspace=0.12)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=200)
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
